name: Verpine
description: The Verpine were a sentient insectoid species from the Roche asteroid field. Best known for their technological aptitude, the Verpine were considered to be among the finest starship engineers in the galaxy.

data.name: Verpine
data.races: Hermaphroditic dominant form and sterile worker drones
data.distinctions: Radio wave senses, technological aptitude, hardened carapace, short snouts, and small, toothless mouths
